'''Platt Pareja''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There is an Imperial Research Facility being operated primarily by mercenaries.|Mako Ghast, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:PtF" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Platt Pareja and his group of mercenaries were recruited by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to ensure the security of a secret [[Imperial Research Facility (Lok)|Imperial research facility]] on the planet [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="SWG:PtF" /> Because of a feud between [[General/Legends|General]] [[Otto]], the commander of the [[Imperial Outpost (Lok)|Imperial garrison]] on Lok, and Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in charge of research facility, these officers deployed mercenaries and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to guard the facility instead of requisitioning Otto's troops.<ref name="SWG:SwSMA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Sergeant Moore, again|Lok}}</ref> The mercenaries were led by [[Udo Barnet]] and [[Kell Lapaz]].<ref name="SWG:RT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Research This|Lok}}</ref> However, the work at the Imperial Research Facility was quite boring for the mercenaries and some of them including [[Kendo Ryzak]], Platt Pareja, [[Goll Bardok]] and [[Jeran Tarven]], found themselves involved in illegal activities. As they frequently meddled in the affairs of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], the most powerful criminal organization on Lok, they provoked the ire of their leader: the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]].<ref name="SWG:PtF" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Nym and his lieutenant [[Kole]] decided to raid the Imperial research facility to steal the weapons developed there.<ref name="SWG:RtrdaI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the research data and IMGGCUs|Lok}}</ref> As the criminals were planning their operation, [[Mako Ghast]], another lieutenant of Nym, realized that the attack on the facility could be an unique opportunity to get rid of some annoying mercenaries.<ref name="SWG:PtF" /> A group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] affiliated with the Lok Revenants then assaulted the research facility. They had to fight numerous mercenaries to get access to the research complex but they finally retrieved experimental weapons and research data.<ref name="SWG:RtrdaI" /> During the battle, a group of Revenants attacked Kendo Ryzak, Platt Pareja, Goll Bardok and Jeran Tarven and killed them in the ensuring firefight.<ref name="SWG:PtF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Platt Pareja was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PtF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Platt Pareja was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:PtF" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
